Plot cohort centile curves

Source: R/ref-lms-fit.R
plot.wgh_lms.Rd

Draws the centile curves of a fitted cohort LMS-type reference, by group, optionally against the WHO curves for the same centiles.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'wgh_lms'
plot(x, ages = NULL, compare_who = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

x

A wgh_lms object from wgh_fit_lms().

ages

Ages at which the curves are evaluated.

compare_who

Add the WHO curves (grey) for comparison.

...

Display options (see wgh_plot_options()).

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

# \donttest{
lms <- wgh_fit_lms(growdat[growdat$age >= 2, ], "height")
plot(lms)

plot(lms, compare_who = TRUE, title = "Cohort against WHO height centiles")

# }
